product.title: Emerald Interior Acrylic Latex Paint
product.description: This acrylic latex paint offers exceptional washability and coverage with a formula that hides dark colors, resists water streaking, and helps prevent stains from penetrating. This interior paint and primer in one contains anti-microbial agents* that inhibit the growth of mold and mildew on the paint surface and transforms walls with a beautiful finish that speaks for itself. Available in the Designer Color Collection. The Designer Color Collection makes finding the just-right white easier than ever, with our brightest, purest whites and the exquisite colors designers have been asking for. Available in select products. *This product contains agents which inhibit the growth of mold and mildew on the surface of this paint film
